mostWorthwhile.text: Making gas glow in two different ways was worthwhile: the fringe shone through ionization and electron capture, while the jet produced a shock.

leastWorthwhile.text: Following the outflow through the bridge and pillars was interesting but felt like a detour while I was looking for the second glow.

surprise.text: Infalling gas produced an outward jet, guided by magnetic fields near the star and disk.

arbitrary.text: The two outflow interactions had clear physical purposes, although I was guessing whether either would produce a glow. Nothing felt distinctly arbitrary.

continue.text: I would continue: the different paths taken by the gas and the explanations of how it shines made me curious about what happens next.
